selection.strata: round-robin 2,3,4+ groups; deterministic seeded shuffle within strata; efficiency pilot, not random population sample

scope: Exactly the frozen50 existing caption candidates; no replacements or resampling based on model output.
time_annotations: Video-MME QA provides no authoritative fact-level temporal gold used here; caption windows are proposals. Refined spans are sampled source witness intervals, not frame-perfect event boundaries.
modalities: Original decoded video frames and synchronized original SRT; no audio stream. Claims needing audio without usable subtitles remain unresolved.
resume: Completed stage cache is keyed by full text, frame hashes, protocol and frozen implementation; terminal question results skipped; explicit --retry-failed retries technical failures only.
